last day of August, summer winding down

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Collect drifting fog wisps before they condense into rain — each wisp you miss becomes a droplet that shrinks your play area.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: drag to steer a lighthouse beam and collect wisps
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: filling the sky meter when you chain five wisps in a row
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: wisps accelerate and rain patches appear that block collection paths
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor fog gradients over a gray San Francisco bay

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort floating code fragments into 'yours' vs 'machine's' bins before the compiler deadline — mis-sorts corrupt the build output.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: swipe left/right to bin ambiguous code snippets
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: combo streak when you correctly classify three blurred snippets in a row
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: fragments merge together and the compile timer shrinks each round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green on black with glitch artifacts on mis-sorted lines

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap frozen grocery items in the right thaw order before the commissary freezer door locks — wrong sequence triggers the alarm.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: timing tap sequence on frost-covered items
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: satisfying cascade when you thaw an entire shelf without a single alarm ping
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: items re-freeze mid-thaw and decoy products appear on neighboring shelves
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: frosted glass UI with neon price tags and cold breath particles

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to dive, release to climb — thread a passenger jet through stadium light towers during a low-altitude flyover.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: hold/release altitude control through obstacle gaps
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: crowd roar multiplier peaks when you nail the centerline between towers
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: towers multiply and crosswinds push you off the flight path
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: retro airline poster colors with a silhouetted crowd below
